name: Calendar Core
description: Shared calendar feed manager for the calendar_* widget family. Add iCal URLs (Google Calendar / iCloud / Outlook all expose them) on the admin page with a name + colour, point Discover at a self-hosted CalDAV server (Baikal / Radicale / Nextcloud) to enumerate and add its calendars in one click, or pull calendars straight from Home Assistant (any calendar.* entity, via the Home Assistant Core plugin's connection). Feeds can carry basic / digest credentials for a private server, and both calendars (VEVENT) and todo lists (VTODO) are read. One fetch per feed, cached 15 minutes.
